g.text: TAIL ORIENTATION: exposed tail contacts on B.Cu; PI stiffener on F.Cu (skin side).

g.desc: TAIL ORIENTATION: exposed tail contacts on B.Cu; PI stiffener on F.Cu (skin side).

g.text: Distal tail U-turns up the distal module wall, entering J1 proximally; maintain pin 1, no axial twist.

g.desc: Distal tail U-turns up the distal module wall, entering J1 proximally; maintain pin 1, no axial twist.

g.text: Optional contact build: 2-3 SMD spring pins with 2 mm heads per electrode; not fitted or included in this flex BOM.

g.desc: Optional contact build: 2-3 SMD spring pins with 2 mm heads per electrode; not fitted or included in this flex BOM.

g.text: If spring pins are selected, qualify attachment, travel, skin pressure and finish before assembly.

g.desc: If spring pins are selected, qualify attachment, travel, skin pressure and finish before assembly.

g.text: PASSIVE FLEX: 24 fabricated 6.5 mm skin electrodes + one fabricated 20-contact tail; no purchased parts.

g.desc: PASSIVE FLEX: 24 fabricated 6.5 mm skin electrodes + one fabricated 20-contact tail; no purchased parts.

g.text: All eight B contacts share BIAS_E, driven by the main-board bias amplifier; no skin contact is GND.

g.desc: All eight B contacts share BIAS_E, driven by the main-board bias amplifier; no skin contact is GND.

g.text: Each electrode is pin 1. GND is reserved for shield/return copper, not a skin electrode.
